notes: Numbers you type are the numbers Crisp uses. Ask for audio “6dB louder” and it lifts it by 6dB — every decibel figure used to apply the same fixed 2× instead, and the card said “2×” as if you had asked for it. A GIF “from 20s to 55s” is now described as 20s–50s rather than “the first 30s”. Asking a 480p clip for 1080p reaches 1080p instead of stopping at 960p and telling you it could not go further. And cutting more than the clip has now explains that, instead of saying it did not understand.
